text: I wanted to love this but it tested my patience. The mining section goes on forever -- I get it, phosphate, bones, hard labor -- and by the time we reach the actual betrayal, which is the heart of the story, we're already deep into it. The voice is strong and I liked the narrator, but this needed to be half as long. The ending doesn't land for me either. After all that buildup I wanted something to actually happen, not another paragraph about how the narrator can't finish what she's saying.
